summary: Iteration 5 frontend-only regression on FloatingCTA refactor. ALL acceptance criteria PASS. (A) Hero contains BOTH hero-call-btn (Call Now) and hero-quote-btn (Get Free Quote) visible on desktop (row) and mobile (column stack) — verified via bounding-box, not fixed, scroll away with hero. (B) Floating action bar hidden at scrollY=0: on mobile sticky-call-btn/sticky-quote-btn DOM nodes absent (AnimatePresence unmount), on desktop floating-call-btn/floating-quote-btn absent. After scrolling ~4800px via page.mouse.wheel the bar appears; after scrolling back to top (scrollY=0) it unmounts again. (C) MOBILE 390x844 after scroll: full-width bar at bottom — sticky-call-btn bbox=(x=0,y=778,w=195,h=66) bg=rgb(29,29,31) charcoal, sticky-quote-btn bbox=(x=195,y=778,w=195,h=66) bg=rgb(30,58,138) navy, total width=390, height 66px, tel:0414698435 & /contact hrefs correct. (C) DESKTOP 1920x900 after scroll: compact lower-right group — floating-call-btn bbox=(x=1569.3,y=834,w=136.5,h=42), floating-quote-btn bbox=(x=1715.8,y=835,w=180.2,h=40); group_total_width=326.7 (well under 960 = half viewport), left edge 1569 > 960 (lower-right). Mobile sticky testids not visible on desktop (md:hidden confirmed). (D) Footer copyright '© 2026 SplitsPro. All rights reserved.' bottom=695.5 sits above sticky bar top=778 on mobile — pb-24 on footer works. Animation uses framer-motion opacity+y (no infinite pulse). REGRESSION: all 12 routes (/, /about, /split-systems, /ducted, /cleaning, /repairs, /servicing, /gallery, /reviews, /service-areas, /faq, /contact) render with ZERO pageerrors. Navbar bottom y=56 < Hero H1 top y=257 (no overlap on desktop). /contact quote form (name/phone/suburb/shadcn service select/submit) submits successfully -> quote-success visible.
critical_code_review_comments: FloatingCTA.jsx cleanly separates mobile (md:hidden full-width grid-cols-2) and desktop (hidden md:flex compact lower-right) — good responsive isolation, fixes the prior iteration's framer-motion + Tailwind translate conflict.
Scroll threshold Math.max(innerHeight*0.85, 480) is robust across viewports; verified hero (h-screen) fully clears before bar appears.

AnimatePresence unmounts the bar completely at top (DOM node removed) — this means test scripts should query after scroll (as expected), and there is no residual invisible overlay blocking clicks near the bottom of the hero.

Home.jsx hero CTA buttons now use !px-7 !py-3 override — works but the !important overrides on utility classes are a small maintenance smell; consider a dedicated btn size variant if reused elsewhere.
StickyCallBar.jsx (dead file) still present in /app/frontend/src/components/ and unused; safe to delete to reduce dead code (carry-over comment from iteration 4).
test_credentials: None required — public marketing site. /app/memory/test_credentials.md not applicable.
seed_data_creation: One quote lead 'TEST Iter5 Playwright' created via /api/quotes (from /contact form submission verification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: FloatingCTA behavior fully verified. Key selectors: hero-call-btn/hero-quote-btn (inside hero), sticky-call-btn/sticky-quote-btn (mobile only, appear after scrollY>~717 on 844h viewport), floating-call-btn/floating-quote-btn (desktop only, appear after scrollY>~765 on 900h). Use page.mouse.wheel to scroll (Lenis intercepts window.scrollTo). PageLoader ~2.6-2.8s. shadcn Select for /contact service field — click testid then click [role=option]. The bar is AnimatePresence-controlled so DOM nodes are absent when hidden (not just invisible).
rca of the issue: No open issues — the prior iteration's framer-motion transform vs Tailwind -translate-x-1/2 conflict is resolved by restructuring the mobile bar to be a full-width grid (inset-x-0) with no translate, and the desktop group to bottom-6 right-6 with no translate. Both wrappers now only animate opacity + y, so inline transforms never clash with layout classes.
